d: A Kochi-based student of architecture won the 28th Charles Correa Gold Medal in architecture in Mumbai on Thursday (October 22, 2026). His project, ‘Energy Commons: Reimagining energy infrastructure as a place for civic engagement,’ reimagined essential energy infrastructure as a civic resource, transforming a conventionally restricted space into a place of shared public life. Radhakrishnan M.S. is a student of Seed APJ Abdul School of Environmental Design in Kochi.
